Jharkhand News: jharkhand ki bari khabren | Asian Games | SIR in Jharkhand | CM Hemant | Weather News
Khabar chaeebasa se hai...jahan kasturba gandhi balika vidyalay men aathvin kaksha ki chhatra sneha tanti ki achanak tabiyat bigarne se maut ho gaee...is dukhad ghatna ke bad vidyalay parisar aur aaspas ke kshetr men shok ka mahaul hai...vahin is ghatna ne aavasiy vidyalyon men chhatraon ki svasthy suraksha aur aapatkalin chikitsa vyavastha par ganbhir saval khare kar die hain
